title: polygonum calophyllum
intro: Polygonum calophyllum, commonly known as Batai or Kaluwara, is a plant species in the Polygonaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian and Pacific Island medicine to treat various health conditions. Polygonum calophyllum is valued for its health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and soothe wounds. Its therapeutic actions include being a febrifuge, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, with bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids contributing to its medicinal properties.
